# Mir Yoke — minimal agent-guided harness starter

## Supported consumer payload
- `starter/README.md` — preservation-first adoption guide
- `starter/HARNESS.md` — canonical repository contract template
- `starter/CLAUDE.md` — Claude entrypoint
- `starter/AGENTS.md` — generated Codex entrypoint

The starter is documentation-only. It does not require a Mir CLI, installer, plugin, hook, memory
database, spec tree, sub-agent, daemon, receipt, or platform-specific runtime.

## Maintainer checks
- `uv run pytest tests/test_minimal_starter.py -q`
- `uv run python scripts/verify_codex_sync.py`
- `uv run ruff check`

Everything outside `starter/` is optional reference, history, or maintainer material.
